response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT batting_hand, appearance_count, 1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS count_divided_by_average FROM hand_counts
